summary: No findings. Tampered stored session records (IndexedDB, same-origin) are first run through parseSessionRecord (RangeError, abort) and then, inside the same strict readwrite transaction, rejected by isEnded with a ConstraintError before any delete/put/add. This closes the earlier check-then-write race (MINOR ended-no-recheck-in-transaction) and fails closed. On the reject path transaction.abort() rolls back, so nothing is deleted or overwritten: an ended session's record and report stay intact, and the Game Config values are kept in component state. The GameConfigScreen focus effect only calls focus() on a ref and takes no input. The hold-scope hook stays in e2e/support/hold-writes.ts, used only via page.addInitScript/page.evaluate, and nothing in src/ imports it, so it is not bundled into dist. No new dependencies, secrets, logging or randomness.
